name: Todd The Tubby Toad
description:
About This Game

Todd is a toad...and very tubby one. So much so that he can't really use his legs, but he has an incredible grappling tongue that will carry him and his friends through this puzzle-platforming adventure! Navigate the mysterious forest wizard's hidden domain; from the dankest sewers, the ruined gradens, the frozen cellar and the boiling hot dungeon to the mechanical marvels waiting at the top of the highest tower. Can Todd and his friends get their wishes granted? Or will their ambitions go belly-up?
short_desc: Todd, a tubby toad that can't jump or walk, but with an incredible grappling-tongue, has found his way into a mysterious wish-granting wizard's tower. Zip, swing and puzzle your way through multiple levels in this physics-based 2D platformer!
developers: Eduardo Cavalcante, Kyla Reine, André Borja, Sebastian Beltran
publishers: Eduardo Cavalcante, Kyla Reine, André Borja, Sebastian Beltran
